description: How this week is going on LinkedIn against the user's own post plan: the plan's subjects and whether each has a draft, what they posted this week and which plan subject each post was, the people they already know who reacted or commented (dormant first), and whether a nudge is due on Thursday. Use for 'how's my LinkedIn week going', 'did I post what I planned', 'who engaged with my post', 'who saw my post'. It never names strangers and has no impressions or follower counts; do not offer those. When plan is null, there is no plan for this week: offer to make one (the post-plan skill). When a subject has a draft_id, link it as [the draft](/graph/object/<draft_id> "note"). When plan is set, end with [See your week](/linkedin/manager), the page with the plan, its drafts, what went up and who noticed. switch says whether the daily LinkedIn manager is on, paused or off. When in_brand_brief is true, Your day keeps the week's subjects out of sight: tell them what is coming in plain words, never call it a plan page or the LinkedIn manager, never link /linkedin/manager or a plan object, say today's post arrives on [Your day](/your-day?show=brand) each morning, and offer a different post today (replace_todays_post). Use this for 'what's my post plan?'.
name: my_linkedin_week
title: My LinkedIn week
